mentions.name: Dog enrichment calendar
mentions.description: This app lets owners configure an inventory of the treats, toys, and activities they have for their dog and sends daily reminders to use a new toy or treat to minimize repetition, with advance reminders for items that require preparation.
mentions.problem: Owners fall into routines and repeatedly give their dog the same few toys and treats despite owning many different ones.
mentions.audience: Dog owners managing enrichment activities for their own pets
mentions.source_excerpt: Dog enrichment calendar - I have a lot of different types of treats, toys and activities that I'd like to do with my dog but I fell into routines and just gave him two or three toys and treats on repeat. So I'm building an app where I'd be able to configure an inventory of all the treats and toys I own and the app would remind me to use a new toy or treat every day, to minimize repetition. You'll also be reminded ahead of time for toys and treats that require preparation
